VENDURE_SHOP_API_URL.description: Your own Shop API. Self-hosted: the operator's installation is both the issuer and the destination, so there is no dashboard to link to.

VENDURE_CHANNEL_TOKEN.description: Selects the active channel, sent as a header. Vendure's own documentation sets it from client-side fetch code, which is the basis for publishing it rather than a statement. You choose the value when creating the channel.

COOKIE_SECRET.description: Signs session cookies to prevent tampering. Vendure's own scaffold and its prose spell this differently, so check which your version reads.

SUPERADMIN_USERNAME.description: The initial administrator, from Vendure's own project scaffold. Half of a login, kept with the other.

SUPERADMIN_PASSWORD.description: That account's password. Change it before the installation is reachable by anyone else.
